'''Adar 23 (May 5)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|998}} - [[Logain]] is taken in a procession through [[Caemlyn]] as proof of his capture.
*{{ne|998}} - [[Rand]], in an attempt to get a view of Logain, climbs and falls to the other side of Caemlyn's palace walls and meets [[Elayne]], [[Gawyn]], and [[Galad]]. He is taken before Queen [[Morgase]] and [[Elaida]] before being released.
*{{ne|998}} - Rand is reunited with [[Moiraine]] and the rest of the group at his inn. Moiraine heals [[Mat]] of his link to the [[ruby-hilted dagger]].
